description: Impose PDF pages into booklet spreads (4 pages per sheet) in correct print order — ready for double-sided printing and folding.

faqs.a: Each sheet holds 2 pages side by side; sheets are ordered front/back so that double-sided printing and one fold produce a correctly ordered booklet.
Yes — blank pages are added automatically to round up to a multiple of 4.
faqs.q: My page count isn't a multiple of 4 — is that OK?

faqs.a: Print double-sided flipping on the short edge, then fold the stack in half and staple the spine.
faqs.q: How do I print the result?

howto: Click "Make booklet" — pages are reordered into spreads automatically.
Print double-sided (flip on short edge), fold and staple.
title: PDF Booklet Imposer
